# SM'S DEX

> SM'S DEX is Shivam Mahajan's interactive software developer portfolio. It presents his work through nine generations of Pokédex-inspired interfaces and hosts a reviewed public developer roster.

## Main pages

- [Shivam Mahajan — Software Developer](https://shivammahajan.com/): Experience, selected projects, technical results, contact links, and the public developer dex.
- [Homepage Markdown](https://shivammahajan.com/index.html.md): Clean text version of the homepage for AI agents and text-based clients.
- [Shivam Mahajan's resume](https://shivammahajan.com/resume.pdf): Downloadable resume in PDF format.

## Key facts

- Shivam Mahajan works with Python, Kotlin, Kafka, PySpark, Snowflake, React, and Solidity.
- His portfolio records 425+ test suites, 5 million processed events, and 2,600+ solved algorithmic problems.
- He completed a technology apprenticeship at Morgan Stanley from August 2025 to August 2026.
- He is currently available for software engineering roles.

## Public roster

Visitors can submit a short developer dex entry through the Add Pokémon form. Each submission becomes a GitHub issue, passes automated validation, and reaches the site only after its generated pull request is reviewed and merged.
